shards.range: Front matter and Chapters 1–2 (printed pp. i–xx and 1–85)
shards.note: Definitions and properties of spectral densities followed by classical nonparametric estimation: periodogram, correlogram, FFT computation, windowing, and refined estimators.
Parametric spectral estimation for rational AR/MA/ARMA models and for line spectra, including Yule–Walker, subspace, MUSIC, min-norm, and ESPRIT methods.
Filter-bank and Capon approaches, then spatial spectral estimation and array processing with nonparametric and parametric methods.

shards.range: Appendices A–D, Bibliography, subject-grouped references, and Index (printed pp. 328–427)
shards.note: Linear algebra, Cramér–Rao bounds, model-order selection, selected exercise answers, and the book's reference apparatus.

notes: The author-hosted PDF was verified as a complete, unencrypted 447-page book. The contents enumerate six chapters, four appendices, bibliography, subject-grouped references, and index. Physical PDF pages equal printed Arabic-numbered pages plus 20: Chapter starts were spot-checked at PDF pages 21, 42, 106, 164, 227, and 283; Appendices A–D at 348, 375, 397, and 419; bibliography at 421; subject-grouped references at 433; and index at 440. The four chapter-boundary shards are balanced at 105, 121, 121, and 100 pages. The author's official page explicitly offers the book for download, establishing full legal reading access; the PDF itself retains Prentice Hall copyright and says all rights are reserved, so this classification does not imply redistribution or adaptation rights.
